abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Alvenor.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Alvenor.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
